BiblicalUsage: Abialbon the Arbathite is named once, in 2 Samuel 23:31, in the list of David's mighty men. He is one of the thirty — a name among the warriors who stood with David, with no deed recorded beside his name.
TheologicalSignificance: A mighty man with no recorded deed: his name is the whole entry. I believe that is enough — the Bible honours the men who stood with David even when it does not tell us what they did, and God keeps the same kind of record of those who stand with Him.
